examples.description: Mark an invoice sent (sent_at stamps automatically when omitted)
Move the due date to 30 Sep 2026 (12:00 UTC of that date)
Add the Singapore-dollar rate to an sg_gst invoice in US dollars (MAS rate for the date of supply)

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_list to find a valid id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not exist in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Re-read the row, merge, and retry with the fresh updated_at.
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at was passed and another writer changed the row first, or the new invoice_number already exists

failure_modes.recovery: To mark an invoice paid, call invoice_payment_record with the invoice id and the amount (integer CENTS) — the status derives from the payment ledger. Cancelled rows never reopen; corrections are a new invoice.
failure_modes.when: status 'paid' was sent by hand (it is payment-flow-owned), or the move is outside the machine (draft→sent/cancelled, sent→cancelled; cancelled is terminal, paid never reopens by hand)

failure_modes.recovery: The call waits for the owner's approval in the Simpler app; tell the owner and do not retry it. Other fields in a separate call are not held up.
failure_modes.when: an agent changes notes or payment_terms on an invoice that is no longer a draft (SIMPLER_SALES_INVOICE_PAYER_TEXT_NEEDS_OWNER): a payer may already be reading them

failure_modes.recovery: For a different scheme or pricing, create a new document with the ones you want. For the date, keep an issue_date in the same rate period or re-issue the document. Resend fx_rate_to_sgd with fx_rate_date.
failure_modes.when: tax_scheme or prices_include_tax differs from the stored value (both are fixed at creation), a new issue_date under a scheme changes the tax rate or leaves a line's tax_code without a rate, or the fx rate is malformed, comes without fx_rate_date, or is on an SGD, my_sst or scheme-less document

preconditions: status 'paid' is payment-flow-owned — money truth is recorded, not declared. Call invoice_payment_record with the invoice id and the amount (integer CENTS); it records the payment, derives the status and echoes the remaining balance.

Status moves are machine-checked: draft→sent/cancelled, sent→cancelled; cancelled is TERMINAL and a paid invoice never reopens by hand (a wrong payment is retired with invoice_payment_delete — approval required — which re-derives the status). Moving to sent stamps sent_at automatically when omitted.
'overdue' is never a stored status — it derives from the balance and due_date (invoice_read returns state and is_overdue); do not try to set it.

due_date is epoch millis, and the invoice is due on the calendar day that instant falls on in the business time zone (sales_settings.timezone, unset = Asia/Singapore). To move the due date, send 12:00 UTC of that date (30 Sep 2026 = 1790769600000): it falls on that date in every listed zone, while 00:00 UTC falls on the day before west of UTC.

description: Edits an invoice's header fields and status. status 'paid' cannot be set here — it derives from the payment ledger, so call invoice_payment_record instead. Status moves are machine-checked (draft to sent/cancelled, sent to cancelled); cancelled is terminal and a paid invoice never reopens by hand. A move to 'sent' stamps sent_at automatically when omitted, and currency is ledger-locked once any live payment exists. An agent's change to notes or payment_terms on an issued invoice waits for the owner's approval; on a draft it does not. tax_scheme and prices_include_tax are fixed at creation, as is the tax rate. NEXT: invoice_payment_record to settle money, invoice_read to verify.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

fx_rate_date.description: The date the fx rate is for, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with fx_rate_to_sgd.

fx_rate_to_sgd.description: sg_gst invoices in a currency other than SGD: Singapore dollars per 1 unit of the invoice currency as a decimal string, up to 6 decimals ("1.3502"), from a source IRAS accepts (MAS, a local bank, Bloomberg, Reuters, Oanda) for the date of supply. Send with fx_rate_date. Or send fx_rate_to_sgd_ppm (1.3502 → 1350200).
